intent_and_evidence: Centralises all database CRUD operations behind a generic typed abstraction; concrete subclasses inherit get/get_multi/create/update/remove and override with domain-specific queries. FastAPI endpoints call repository instances instead of raw SQLAlchemy sessions.
CRUDDataProduct specialises CRUDBase with raster metadata, bounding-box caching, like/view aggregation and active-record filtering — all hidden behind a consistent repository interface.
Wraps file-permission lifecycle (create-with-data-product, create-with-raw-data, get-by-data-product) behind repository interface; called automatically from CRUDDataProduct.create_with_flight.
Repository for Flight entities; exposes flight-scoped queries isolating campaign and project relationships.
Repository for Project entities; provides member, publication, and metrics queries.
Repository for User entities; handles password hashing, email look-up and approval state.

participant_roles: Injector=FastAPI Depends(); Provider=get_db; Provider=get_current_user; Provider=get_current_approved_user; Consumer=API endpoint functions
intent_and_evidence: FastAPI's Depends() injects DB sessions and authenticated user objects into endpoint signatures; consumers declare their needs declaratively without constructing them — textbook DI.

ProtectedStaticFiles subclasses RangedStaticFiles and intercepts every ASGI __call__; it authenticates the request via verify_static_file_access before delegating to the parent, adding on-demand vector-parquet and FlatGeobuf generation. A transparent proxy that adds behaviour without changing the interface.

participant_roles: Strategy=AccessPolicyRule (ABC); ConcreteStrategy=SuperuserRule; ConcreteStrategy=ProjectOwnerRule; ConcreteStrategy=EmbargoPolicyRule; ConcreteStrategy=RoleBasedRule; Context=AccessPolicyEngine
intent_and_evidence: AccessPolicyRule defines a single evaluate(context)->AccessDecision method; each concrete rule encapsulates one access-control algorithm; AccessPolicyEngine selects and composes them at runtime — classic Strategy.

AccessPolicyEngine.evaluate_chain() iterates ordered AccessPolicyRule list; first ALLOW or DENY short-circuits the chain; NOT_APPLICABLE passes to next handler — Chain of Responsibility over a Strategy hierarchy.

Subclasses FastAPI's OAuth2 to read the access token from a cookie instead of the Authorization header; overrides __call__ while preserving the full OAuth2 interface — Decorator/Proxy idiom at framework level.
On 401 the response interceptor queues all in-flight requests, calls /auth/refresh-token, then replays the queue on success — chain-of-responsibility-like pattern for token refresh in the frontend.
